parameters.name: CurrentGatewayId
parameters.description: The IotId of the current gateway device. IotId is the unique identifier generated by IoT Platform for the device. You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation to query the IotId.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to query the ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.name: NewGatewayId
parameters.description: The IotId of the new gateway device that you want to use as a replacement. IotId is the unique identifier generated by IoT Platform for the device. You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation to query the IotId.
